t: This is Plender Street, a street in the London Borough of Camden. It's named after William Plender, 1st Baron Plender, who lived from 1861 to 1946. He was a British chartered accountant and public servant. He was known as Sir William Plender from 1911, then Sir William Plender, Baronet, from 1923, and finally became a baron in 1931. So the name on the street marks an accountant who rose through the ranks of public life, from knighthood to the House of Lords.
